subject.title: feat(onboarding): recommend plugins and skills from installed apps

question: Should onboarding scan installed macOS apps and send app metadata to the configured model and ClawHub by default, or require an explicit consent or opt-in step first?
rationale: This intentionally changes the onboarding trust boundary and transmits local inventory metadata; source review cannot choose that user-consent policy without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Consent before scan
options.body: Prompt before inventory collection and outbound matching, with a clear skip path and remembered setting.

options.title: Default-on with complete disclosure
options.body: Keep automatic discovery only after explicit maintainer acceptance and accurate pre-scan disclosure of every transmitted field and destination.

options.title: Opt-in setting only
options.body: Default the feature off and let users enable it from onboarding or configuration.

recommendation.title: Consent before scan
recommendation.body: Prompt before inventory collection and outbound matching, with a clear skip path and remembered setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The onboarding redesign document and coordinated implementation make steipete the strongest available owner for the trust-boundary choice.
